title: The Rescue at the River
production_note: Three-character interaction test: shared attention, coordinated rescue, rope handoff and group departure.

scenes.heading: A Team Reaches the River
scenes.caption: Three explorers arrive at a fast-moving river.
scenes.narration: Maya, Arun and Leena have been exploring the forest together. Their route ends at a wide river, where the water moves quickly over slippery stones.

scenes.heading: Choosing a Safe Crossing
scenes.caption: They study the stones and discuss another route.
scenes.narration: Maya points toward a line of stepping stones. Arun crouches to inspect the water, but Leena spots a fallen tree that offers a safer way across.

scenes.heading: A Sudden Slip
scenes.caption: Arun loses his footing on the wet rock.
scenes.narration: Before they can change direction, Arun steps onto a wet rock. His foot slides, his arms fly outward, and he reaches for help as Maya turns toward him.

scenes.heading: Working Together
scenes.caption: Leena throws a rope. Maya helps pull Arun to safety.
scenes.narration: Leena quickly takes a rope from her pack and throws one end. Maya catches it and passes it to Arun. They brace their feet and pull together until he reaches the riverbank.

scenes.heading: Back on Solid Ground
scenes.caption: The three friends regroup and continue together.
scenes.narration: Arun catches his breath. Maya offers her hand and helps him stand. Leena points toward the safer route. They have learned that the best way forward is often together.
